method: Targeted WCAG relative-luminance spot checks. CSS foreground colors were alpha-composited against nearby background pixels sampled from the rendered screenshots. This is a small sample, not a page-wide or formal conformance audit.
limitations: These two sampled surfaces do not establish contrast for every route or component.
Gradient and translucent surfaces vary with position; the listed ratios apply only to the recorded nearby samples.
A complete accessibility review still requires broader contrast, reading-order, and assistive-technology evaluation.
